stock.description: Yue Da International Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, primarily focusing on the factoring business within the People's Republic of China. The firm delivers a range of services, including comprehensive accounts receivable management, collection solutions, and expert consultancy. Established in 2001, its main office is situated in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong. In December 2018, the company transitioned from its previous identity, Yue Da Mining Holdings Limited, to its present name. It functions as a subsidiary of Yue Da Capital (HK) Limited.
